results.sentence: Run 1 of planted-synthseg ended partial: 16 of 20 units done, 3 failed (2 for a missing input — stack-878, stack-877; 1 where the tool failed — stack-879), 1 unreported (stack-880), and 4 units broke a declared check — 3 with qc_general_white_matter under 0.65 (worst 0.41: stack-881, stack-882, stack-883) and 1 with qc_general_csf under 0.65 (worst 0.52: stack-881) — so a campaign over those 4 units is proposed for a person to make.

Run 2 of planted-samseg ended done with 8 of 8 units done and none failed; two units broke a declared check: stack-897 measured an intracranial volume of 850000, under the 900000 floor, and stack-898 measured 2400000, over the 2300000 ceiling — both are failed segmentations more often than a head, so a person should look at them; no campaign is proposed, a person makes one.
Run 3 of planted-mriqc ended done with 6 of 6 units done; no unit failed; no unit broke a check; and no campaign is needed.
